user.title: Issue Reporter Setup
user.description: Choose how Issue Reporter should authenticate with GitHub.

auth_pat.title: Personal Access Token
auth_pat.description: Enter a GitHub PAT with issue creation permission (`public_repo` or repository Issues: Read & Write).

auth_github_app.title: GitHub App (Bot) Credentials
auth_github_app.description: Configure your GitHub App (for example `faserf-hermes-agent[bot]`). Installation ID is auto-detected if left empty.

auth_device_flow.title: GitHub OAuth Device Flow
auth_device_flow.description: Enter the OAuth App Client ID configured with Device Flow enabled.

device_flow_wait.title: Authorize in GitHub
device_flow_wait.description: Open **{verification_uri}** and enter code **`{user_code}`** to authorize Issue Reporter.

fallback_auth.title: 3rd-Party Repository Fallback (Optional)
fallback_auth.description: A GitHub App can only open issues on repositories where it is installed. Optionally attach a user token for 3rd-party repositories.

scope.title: Monitoring Scope & Privacy Defaults
scope.description: Choose which repositories to monitor automatically. Authenticated owner: **{owner}**.

data.dry_run: Enable Global Dry-Run Mode (preview drafts without posting)
data.require_approval: Require Manual Approval Before Creating Issues
data.custom_redactions: Extra Private Domains / Words to Redact (comma-separated)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GitHub
reauth_confirm.description: Stored GitHub credentials failed or expired. Please provide updated credentials.

progress.wait_device_flow: Waiting for GitHub Device Flow authorization at {verification_uri} with code {user_code}...

error.invalid_app_auth: GitHub App ID, Installation ID, or PEM private key could not be verified.
error.device_flow_error: Could not initiate or complete GitHub OAuth Device Flow.

abort.device_flow_error: GitHub Device Flow authorization expired or was denied.

data.require_approval: Require Manual Approval Before Creating Issues
data.max_issues_per_repo_day: Maximum issues per repository per day
data.allow_dev_edge: Allow reporting from dev / edge pre-releases
data.comment_on_newer_version: Comment once on matching open issue if running newer version
data.include_core_addons: Include official core_* add-ons in discovery

data.ignore_network_errors: Ignore network, DNS, timeout, and 502/503/504 errors
data.ignore_auth_errors: Ignore local authentication, 401/403, and expired session errors
data.ignore_lifecycle_errors: Ignore shutdown and task cancellation errors
data.custom_ignore_patterns: Custom ignore regex patterns (one per line)

data.custom_redactions: Extra literal domains / keywords to mask
data.custom_redaction_regexes: Extra redaction regex patterns (one per line)
data.strict_entropy_guard: Enable strict high-entropy Pre-Flight Leak Guard

data.github_token: New Primary PAT (leave blank to keep existing)
data.fallback_token: New Fallback PAT (leave blank to keep existing)

error.invalid_regex: One or more regular expressions are invalid.

abort.no_targets_found: No matching integrations or add-ons discovered yet.

pending_draft_approval.title: Review GitHub issue draft for {target}
pending_draft_approval.description:
Issue Reporter prepared a sanitized issue for **{repo}**:

`{title}`

Excerpt:
```
{excerpt}
```

leak_guard_blocked.title: Pre-flight Leak Guard blocked report for {target}
leak_guard_blocked.description: Issue Reporter aborted an automated GitHub issue for **{target}** because potential unmasked data remained ({reasons}). Review your custom redaction rules or run `issue_reporter.test_redaction`.

not_loaded.message: Issue Reporter is not loaded yet.
